transformation.title: Transformation preview
transformation.description: The vetted DI rule rewrites Seasar2 component and binding annotations to Spring annotations. It validates Java syntax, not runtime semantics. A dicon definition remains a separate configuration item.
transformation.descriptionValidation: The vetted validation rule rewrites plain SAStruts @Required fields to Jakarta Bean Validation @NotNull. It validates Java syntax only; controller and message migration remain separate items.
transformation.descriptionForm: The vetted model rule removes ActionForm inheritance from a plain form model. It validates Java syntax only; controller and validation work remain separate items.
transformation.descriptionJakarta: The vetted namespace rule rewrites supported javax imports to Jakarta for Spring Boot 3. It changes imports only and validates syntax; dependency and runtime verification remain manual.
transformation.descriptionData: The vetted data-access rule rewrites a supported read-only JdbcManager selectBySql/getResultList chain to Spring JdbcTemplate with BeanPropertyRowMapper. It validates syntax only; update APIs, transactions, and SQL semantics remain manual.
transformation.descriptionMessages: The vetted message rule rewrites non-ASCII Unicode escapes in message values as UTF-8 text for Spring's default MessageSource encoding. It preserves keys, placeholders, and comments; message APIs and JSP tags remain separate items.
transformation.descriptionJspTags: The vetted JSP rule rewrites self-closing Struts bean:message tags as JSTL fmt:message when only key and bundle are present, adds the JSTL fmt taglib when needed, and removes an unused bean taglib. It validates tag structure, not full JSP compilation; form, error, and custom tags remain manual.
transformation.descriptionController: The vetted skeleton rule creates a new Spring @Controller from explicit Struts action mappings and forwards. It does not modify the legacy action and does not migrate method bodies.
transformation.unsupported: No vetted transformation rule supports this item yet. It remains a planning task.
transformation.sourceWarning: Applying writes the source file. A backup is created first, and restore refuses to overwrite a file that changed after apply.
transformation.createWarning: Applying creates a new controller file. Existing files are never overwritten; restore removes the generated file if it is unchanged.
transformation.scopeMessages: Struts message bundle → UTF-8 Spring messages
transformation.scopeController: Struts action mappings → Spring controller skeleton
transformation.confirm: I understand this writes the source file and creates a backup.
transformation.confirmCreate: I understand this creates a new file.
transformation.appliedNote: Applied. Rescan the project to refresh inventory evidence; restore is available below.
transformation.createdNote: Created. Review the skeleton; restore removes the generated file.
transformation.supersededNote: A newer proposal superseded this one.
